title: Lesson Schema
description: Lesson within a unit, containing items (ContentItem, ExerciseItem, QuizItem, ContentSequenceItem)

globalId.description: Stable RFC 4122 UUID identifying this lesson across re-imports. Required by NORMATIVE §4.4: every Unit, Lesson, Item, and Question MUST carry a globalId.

tags.description: Optional taxonomic tags for filtering, search, and gradebook grouping. Free-form strings; conventional namespaces use colons (e.g. 'algebra:linear-equations', 'stage:lower-secondary', 'grade:9'). Independent of any tags on inner items or questions.

objectiveIds.description: Objective IDs assigned to this lesson (references course.objectives[].id)

items.description: Array of Item objects (polymorphic: content, exercise, quiz, contentsequence, signpost)
